scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Seeded elementwise Bernoulli keep mask and inverse-keep scaling
scientific_intent.numerical_method: Philox4x32-10 counter RNG, native Float32 uniform conversion and multiplication
scientific_intent.community_use: Reproducible stochastic regularization primitive; no model training or generalization experiment
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Every seeded mask and scaled Float32 output bit exact against independent integer RNG oracle and both GPU references; signed zero included
limitations: Only two 4-aligned sizes and four probabilities; arbitrary vector tails unmeasured
p1..3 captures are explicit untimed deterministic replays; p4 is actual timed pipeline final state

shared_observed_usage_windows.scope: Consumed inference tokens during declared phase, including repeated/cached context and any coordination. Marker-turn alignment is approximate; not exclusive source translation or monetary billing. Cached input and reasoning are subsets, not extra totals. No historical recovery. Parent/shared workflow spans overlap subphases and must not be added to them.
shared_observed_usage_windows.counter_span_interpretation: Observed counter difference; alignment and interleaving prevent exclusive billed-cost claims. Zero/no-new-event spans cannot imply zero translation effort.
